title: Cap. III Sol. Rat. 13: same occasion from divine foresight — Augustine De bono pers. 2.15
pass_a_gloss: And that a wholly similar occasion can be taken from the doctrine of the Divine foresight (which nonetheless no one except an atheist, or one greatly unskilled, rejects) Augustine has demonstrated, On the Good of Perseverance book 2 chapter 15.
pass_b_english: And Augustine showed (De bono perseverantiae 2.15) that a wholly similar occasion can be taken from the doctrine of divine foresight — which no one but an atheist, or one greatly unskilled, rejects.
source_text: Atque similem prorsus occasionem desumi posse ex doctrina praescientiae Divinae (quam tamen nemo nisi atheus, aut valde imperitus rejicit) demonstravit Augustinus, De bono perseverantiae lib. 2. cap. 15.
